description.value: The Cove Coffee Company sits at the end of an historic 800-foot boardwalk at Telegraph Cove Resort on the northeast coast of Vancouver Island, offering gourmet coffees, house-baked goods, and ice cream with sweeping views of Johnstone Strait. A companion venue, Sally's Food Bar, greets visitors at the resort entrance with fresh-baked pizza, cinnamon buns, wraps, sandwiches, and breakfast options. Both cafés serve a hub of whale-watching and wildlife tourism in one of the most remote stretches of the BC coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is 'The Cove Coffee Company' (co-branded with 'Sally's Food Bar'), a seasonal café within Telegraph Cove Resort serving gourmet coffees, baked goods, wraps, and sandwiches; the phrase 'while strolling down the historic boardwalk' confirms to-go/takeout service. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill options are mentioned anywhere on the site. The resort suffered a December 2024 fire that is affecting the restaurant and pub rebuild, but news posts confirm the resort and coffee shops reopened for the May 2025 and 2026 seasons.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Telegraph Cove Coffee Co.' but the resort website consistently names the venue 'The Cove Coffee Company' (part of 'Sally's Food Bar & The Cove Coffee Company').
Seasonal operation only: resort open May–September, closed October–May.

A fire in December 2024 caused significant damage to the resort's restaurant, pub, and parts of the boardwalk; the restaurant/pub rebuild is ongoing as of 2026, though the coffee shop appears unaffected.
Phone number (1-800-200-4665) sourced from website; OSM record contains no phone number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A genuine café stop at a well-known destination on a remote stretch of northern Vancouver Island where services are scarce; useful to touring cyclists for food and coffee.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM node maps only the coffee shop. The resort also operates accommodation, RV camping, a marina, a general store, and a pub — separate OSM records may exist or be warranted for those facilities.
